recipes.name: Balsamic & Basil Bruschetta
instructions: Add all of the ingredients to a medium bowl and gently toss until combined.
Although the dish can be enjoyed immediately, it’s best to cover the tomatoes and let them sit in the fridge for at least 2 hours to allow the flavours to meld, if possible.
Serve fresh on toasted bread, or even toast together with the bread in the oven for a warm bruschetta. Garnish with fresh basil if desired. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Best to enjoy the same day it's made. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 day.
